(āḥ)༄༅/ /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nyams len bzhugs so/ /༈/na mo gu ru we/rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nyams len ni/rje sa che

tei:div.tei:p: (āḥ)༄༅// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nyams len bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru we/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nyams len ni/ rje sa chen gyi zhal nas/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myong*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlobs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes gsungs pas/ dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ srod thun la bsgom bzlas byas nas thun mjug tu bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'o// ma bsgom na skad cig gis stong nyid bsgom pa'i ngang la nyal lo// gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni snga dro gnyid sad pa dang*/ nam mkha' nas ḍā ma ru'i sgra byung bas/ nam mkha' la sprin brdol ba ltar rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku lam gyis gsal btab/ gsum pa bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ nang mchod la bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa/ 'bru gsum brjod cing srin lag gis lce thog tu myong la/ thugs dam gyi rim pa la 'jug pa'o// bzhi pa tshad med kyi rnal 'byor ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ thog mar skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gi rnam pa can la/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ thugs gsung sku'i lha sgo mtshams ma brgyad rnams kyis bskor ba gtso bo'i rgyab/ khaṇḍa ro ha'i mdun du chos pusti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu ste/ de yang gtso bo ni bla ma dang sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi ngo bo/ chos pusti rnam pa chos dkon mchog 'khor rnams ni dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rang bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ rgyas pa'i phyogs la ngag tu brjod dgos shing*/

bsdus pa'i phyogs la ngag tu ma brjod pa yid la bsam pas chog de nas skyabs 'gro dngos ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan grangs ji ltar rigs pa brjod la thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ gtso bo bla ma 'od sngon po zhu/ rang gi snying khar thim/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ chos pusti 'od dmar po zhu/ mgrin par thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ 'khor gyi lha rnams 'od dkar po zhu/ dpral bar thim/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ zhes pa 'di rgyas pa'i phyogs la ngag tu brjod dgos/ bsdus pa'i phyogs la brjod mi dgos shing*/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral te rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blangs bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rgyas pa'i phyogs la rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas bya zhing*/ bsdus pa'i phyogs la mi dgos so// dga' ba gsum bsgom pa ni/

de nas rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gnas pa de nyid gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod pa ni sku'i dga' ba yin la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum gyis bdud rtsi byin gyis rlobs/ rang gi snying gar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin bam̐ yig bsam ste/ de la bdud rtsi phul bas zag med kyi bdud rtsis tshim par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bdud rtsi myong*/ de yang snying khar bam̐ yig bsgom pa thugs kyi dga' ba/ bdud rtsi myong ba gsung gi dga' ba/ lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ ngag tu/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri steng du sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan la drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid dpa' bo rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin zhing*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pas bdag la dges bzhin du bzhugs pa mngon sum lta bur gsal bar gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam/ de nyid la blo kha zhe med par gtad/ bdag skyid sdug legs nyes ci byung yang*/ re sa ltos sa skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che khyed rang mkhyen snyam pa'i dad gus dung dung pa dang bcas pa thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum zhe thag pa nas gsol ba btab ste bsod nams kyi tshogs bsog pa'o// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i rkyen gyis bla ma de nyid 'od du zhu nas rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med du 'dres te/

bde stong gi rang bzhin du gyur/ ces ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// drug pa bdag lha'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs yongs su gyur pa las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' mar g.yon bskor gyi/ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bskor te gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib las ngan bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gong bu gcig tu gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi gzhal yas khang gi nang du sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rang nyid rnam snang rigs bdag dang bcas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo nu ma brdzis shing*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo rgyab tu bltab pa'i gdong pa mnan pa sku mdog dmar mo bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du brkyangs nas 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang ba dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa 'phros pas/

phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la phog pas chos kyi 'byung gnas gzhal yas khang dang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can la phog pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ 'di rnal 'byor ma'i man ngag gi snying khu/ lus dkyil gyi lha gsal btab pa ni/ ngag tu/ chos 'byung gi nang zla ba'i dbus su bam̐ yig gi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ bam̐ yig gi srog ya ra la wa bzhi las/ shar du ya'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dkar mo/ g.yon du ra'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma ljang gu/ rgyab tu la'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ g.yas su wa'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma ser mo/ mtha'i sngags phreng so gnyis kyang re re nas rnal 'byor ma dmar mo re re ste/ kun sgril lus dkyil gyi lha so bdun legs par gsal bar gyur/ 'di legs par bsgom na'ang nang gi gnas so bdun gyi rlung sems thams cad dbu mar thim nas lam bgrod cing*/ phyi rol gyi yul so bdun na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ dpa' mo rnams dbang du bsdu ba yin no// zhes gsungs so// brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyings su bskor zhing*/ phaiṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ 'gro ba rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ lag pa gnyis pad skor 'khyud rgya byas la/ ngag tu/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ de nas go cha bkod pa ni/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/

spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo rnams gsal bar gyur/ dgu pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis las/ ngag bzlas ni/ rang gi snying gar chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig la sngags phreng kha dog dmar po g.yon du bskor ba/ 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu 'od zer rnam par spyan drangs/ sngags phreng la thim pas/ rgyud byin gyis brlab par gyur/ oṃ gsum ma lan brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa ci nus bzlas la/ de nas yid bzlas bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs zla ba bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa lte bar phab ste/ de'i chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa g.yon bskor du 'khor ba rnams la sems gtad/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/ de nas 'og rlung bskum steng rlung mnan te rlung kha sbyar ci thub 'dzin cing sngags phreng lan gsum mam/ bdun la sogs pa klog pa'i tshul du sems gtad nas sngags bzla/ rlung mi thub pa dang dal bu'i klod/ bzlas pa bsdu ba ni/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing phreng ba mgo thog tu bzhag bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor thun mong ba ni/ rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu ste/

de yang gzugs med khams 'od zer sngon po'i rnam pas lus kyi stod cha la thim/ gzugs khams 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas lus kyi bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pas lus kyi smad kyi cha la thim/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba chos 'byung nyis brtsegs la thim/ de zla ba la thim/ de sngags phreng la thim/ de bam̐ yig la thim/ bam̐ yig khog pa la/ de mgo bo la thim/ de zla tshes la thim/ de thig le la thim/ de nā da la thim/ de yang je phra je phra nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar mi dmigs pa 'od gsal stong pa nyid du gyur/ zhes brjod cing*/ don bsam ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag de nas rtogs pa 'phro na/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ oṃ bam̐ ham̐ yoṃ hriṃ moṃ hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ zhes brjod pas go cha dgod pa gsal btab/ tshams rngam sngags kyi bsrung ba ni/ oṃ sumbha ni sumbha ni hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ akṇa ya ho bha ga wa na badzra rā dza hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ tshar gnyis brjod cing*/ sdigs mdzub phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor bsten la bsrung*/ dga' ba gsum dran pa ni/ hūm̐ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i rang bzhin/ oṃ gsum ma tshar gcig brjod la/ brjod pa dang bral ba'i sgra thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung gi rang bzhin/ hūm̐ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa'i cho 'phrul thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du rnam par dag pa yin no// de nas smon lam gdab pa ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mkha' spyod ma dpal 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog

/'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis// me tog gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thogs nas kyang*// rol mo'i sgra snyan glu dbyangs sogs mchod cing*// mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog /lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang*// des gsungs tshig kyang tshad ma'i mchog yin te// bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis// bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /phun tshogs dge legs kun gyi dpal mnga' ba// rdo rje 'chang dbang paṇa chen nā ro sogs// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i tshogs rnams kyi// byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i bkra shis shog /zhes sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ thun mtshams thams cad du/ rang dang skye 'gro thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur bsgom/ sgra thams cad oṃ gsum ma'i sgra dang*/ yid la dran rtog thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs su bsam zhing bskyang ngo*// bza' btung gang byed/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir bsams la zos pas/ snying gar bla ma yi dam gyi ngo bo bam̐ yig la thim pas mnyes par bsams la longs spyod do// de ltar nā ro mkha' spyod rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len gnad bsdus 'di ni sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis kyi blo mtsho las so// sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
